In the change log, a `config_push` or `parameter_tuning` row on an aggregation router (which affects every site below it) or on each site of a group. Its status later reads `rolled_back`. The description can be bland, such as "scheduled parameter optimisation batch", so do not judge it by its wording. A step at the change time. ... What stays normal. ...
[RB-BAD-CHANGE#05] Bad change and configuration regression > Verification steps: 1. `get_anomalies` for `rrc_success_pct` and `drop_rate_pct` on a set of sites; read the start time. 2. `get_topology`: find the common ancestor of the affected sites (aggregation router or link). 3. `get_changes` for that node and its sites in the 24 hours before the onset. ... `query_kpis`: confirm availability is 100 % and the RRC step is aligned with the change. ...
[RB-RAN-UPGRADE-REGRESSION#02] RAN software upgrade regression > Signature in the data: A software upgrade change on a site or group of sites, executed at night. A short availability dip during the restart is expected, typically one or two steps. Persistent quality loss after the restart. Elevated `drop_rate_pct`, lower `rrc_success_pct`, and sometimes a lower volume that does not recover on the following days. ... Version-specific. ... Repeated restarts. ...

# Grand Tunis Call Setup Failures and Congestion

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** bad_change at `S-TUN-010`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct evidence from change logs, anomaly triggers, and alarms matching the exact timeframe, with maintenance and external events ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-21 18:45 to 2026-09-22 03:45
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-21 18:58
- **Affected:** S-TUN-010, S-TUN-015, S-TUN-017, S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003

## Summary

Parameter optimisation batch RT-2.5 applied at 18:58 caused RRC drops and call setup failures on sites S-TUN-010, S-TUN-015, and S-TUN-017.

Call setup failures and dropped calls affected Grand Tunis sites due to bad changes and a stadium event congestion.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-21 18:45: Alert ALR-0023 started for RRC success drops on S-TUN-010, S-TUN-015, and S-TUN-017. [ALR-0023, T1]
- 2026-09-21 18:58: Parameter optimisation batch RT-2.5 applied via changes on S-TUN-010, S-TUN-015, and S-TUN-017. [CHG-2026-0054, CHG-2026-0055, CHG-2026-0056, T3]
- 2026-09-21 19:10: Football match stadium event EVT-004 started near S-TUN-001. [EVT-004, T2]
- 2026-09-21 19:16: Minor RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH alarm raised on S-TUN-010. [ALM-000439, T4]
- 2026-09-21 19:45: Alert ALR-0024 started for user and volume spikes on S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, and S-TUN-003. [ALR-0024, T1]
- 2026-09-21 22:54: Stadium event EVT-004 ended. [EVT-004, T2]
- 2026-09-22 03:45: Alert ALR-0023 and alarm ALM-000439 cleared after rollback. [ALR-0023, ALM-000439, T1, T4]

## Evidence

- Sites S-TUN-010, S-TUN-015, and S-TUN-017 experienced RRC success drops and high drop rates following parameter tuning. [ALR-0023, CHG-2026-0054, ANM-000300, ANM-000297]
- Sites S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, and S-TUN-003 experienced user, volume, and PRB utilization spikes. [ALR-0024, ANM-000313, ANM-000302, ANM-000306, ANM-000305]
- No maintenance windows were scheduled on the affected sites and their parents during the incident. [T8]
- A football match at Stade Olympique de Rades caused traffic and user spikes on nearby sites. [EVT-004]

## Hypotheses

1. **bad_change** at S-TUN-010: confirmed. Changes applied at 18:58 directly match the onset of RRC failures and anomalies on S-TUN-010, S-TUN-015, and S-TUN-017. [CHG-2026-0054, ALR-0023]
2. **capacity** at S-TUN-001: confirmed. External stadium event caused congestion and traffic spikes matching ALR-0024 metrics. [EVT-004, ALR-0024]

## Ruled out

- T8: Maintenance window checks returned no scheduled maintenance on the affected sites during the incident window.

## Recommended actions

- Review parameter optimization batch RT-2.5 configurations before future deployments.
- Enhance capacity planning for sites near Stade Olympique de Rades during large events.

truth.notes: trap=bad_change_loud_coincidence; A scheduled parameter optimisation batch pushed to the 3 sites of LNK-TUN-02-C regressed RRC success and drop rate until it was rolled back. Root cause node is the first site of the pushed group. Trap: a stadium event in the same region the same evening makes traffic and alarms noisy, and the change record looks innocent. Settled by: (1) the stadium event raises traffic at the venue sites, whereas the pushed sites are other sites that lose RRC success and volume; (2) the regression starts at the change time on exactly the pushed sites and ends at the rollback, long after the event.
